info.title: EVS API
info.description:
USACE Enterprise Visibility Suite API.

Every endpoint that replaces an Oracle APEX page carries an `x-apex-page` extension so the
traceability matrix (legacy/traceability.csv) can be regenerated from the contract.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

AccessibilityReadout.title: AccessibilityReadout
AccessibilityReadout.description: Generated by evs-acr-gen (tools/acr); never edited by hand.

source_as_of.title: Source As Of
source_as_of.description: Newest timestamp inside the source payload

fetched_at.title: Fetched At
fetched_at.description: When the EVS ingestion worker stored it

AsOf.title: AsOf
AsOf.description: Every dataset carries both the source timestamp and when EVS fetched it.

AxeRouteResult.title: AxeRouteResult
AxeRouteResult.description: One axe-core run: route x viewport x theme x reduced-motion cell.

CiDistribution.title: CiDistribution
CiDistribution.description: Histogram with BUILDER threshold bands (good 70 to 100, fair 40 to 69, poor 0 to 39).

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Full OpenACR note for the row

KanbanColumn.title: KanbanColumn
KanbanColumn.description: Port of the Kanban Board column derivation (APEX page 4 region SQL).

gauges.title: Gauges
gauges.description: Latest NOAA NWPS and USGS NWIS readings for the lock

history.title: History
history.description: Status evaluations from the last 24 hours, oldest first

ntni_notices.title: Ntni Notices
ntni_notices.description: Notices to Navigation Interests that name this lock

LockSummary.title: LockSummary
LockSummary.description: One row of the live lock table. Geometry comes from the NDC GIS layer, status from LPMS.

ManualTestRow.title: ManualTestRow
ManualTestRow.description: One assistive technology or input condition from the manual test plan.

ProjectHistoryEvent.title: ProjectHistoryEvent
ProjectHistoryEvent.description: One row of the change history (APEX page 64 Project Change History, sp_project_history).

ProjectMilestone.title: ProjectMilestone
ProjectMilestone.description: Milestone row joined to its project, for the schedule page (route `/schedule`).

current_finish.title: Current Finish
current_finish.description: Target complete; required at 50 percent or more

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: axe incomplete checks plus pa11y needs-review items

value_text.title: Value Text
value_text.description: The figure as the source states it, e.g. 'nearly 15,000 miles'

SrpCitation.title: SrpCitation
SrpCitation.description: Provenance for one headline figure. The UI shows source and year next to every number.

StatusHistoryPoint.title: StatusHistoryPoint
StatusHistoryPoint.description: One status engine evaluation, newest last; the detail panel draws the 24-hour history from these.

ThresholdUpdate.title: ThresholdUpdate
ThresholdUpdate.description: Status engine thresholds editable on `/admin` (APEX Administrator scheme).
